Claim 26 (Currently Amended): A non-aqueous composition comprising: a therapeutically effective amount of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), said NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in a non-aqueous carrier wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises a bio-compatible oil that includes phosphatidylcholine and from 20 wt.% to 80 wt.% phosphatidylcholine; the NSAID to non-aqueous carrier weight ratio is about 5:1 to about 1:5.

Claim 33 (Previously Presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the bio-compatible oil is a lecithin oil, essential oil, vegetable oil, animal oil, vitamin A, vitamin D, vitamin E, fish oil, or mixtures and combinations thereof.

Claim 35 (Currently Amended): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the bio-compatible oil is a lecithin oil.

Claim 41 (Currently Amended): A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and an NSAID selected from the group consisting of aspirin, salicylate, ibuprofen, indomethacin, or combinations thereof, said NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of NSAID to biocompatible oil carrier of about 5:1 to about 1:5.

Claim 50 (Currently Amended): A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and a salicylate NSAID, said salicylate NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of salicylate NSAID to biocompatible oil of about 5:1 to about 1:5.

Claim 51 (Currently Amended): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 50 comprising from 10 wt % to 60 wt% phosphatidylcholine.
